dismissed_comment: False positive independently reviewed against FIPS 204 Algorithm 7 steps 7, 8, 11 and 31 and Algorithm 34. Randomizing this counter would violate the standard and frozen primary answers. The production Writer separately requires the fallible caller-owned fresh randomness provider.
